title: PipelineSpec
description: Machine schema for a pi-fleet pipeline spec. Generated from and validated against docs/pipeline-spec.md (the Markdown there is the source of truth; unknown keys are rejected, every key is required at its level).

scope.description: Free-form description of the work covered by the pipeline: the ticket/objective, the acceptance target, and the boundary of what the loop may touch. Defines the scope-control boundary for reviewers and fixers.

id.description: Unique, stable, lowercase slug identifying the slice (e.g. py-core). Referenced by other slices via deps.

impl_skills.description: Skill names that guide/constrain the implementation (may be empty).

review_skills.description: Review skill names that MUST be evaluated for this slice; each entry maps to one reviewer. The loop must never silently skip a configured skill.

deps.description: Slice ids that must be completed before this slice starts (may be empty). Must reference valid slice ids; cycles are invalid.

name.description: Short unique identifier (e.g. typecheck, test, lint).

cmd.description: Shell command run from the project root. Exit code 0 = pass; non-zero = fail.
